Nora Keel is a forty-two-year-old archivist with a silver bob, a navy coat, and a brass key. Owen Hart is a thirty-one-year-old courier with a red beard, a brown jacket and a canvas satchel.

In the evening Nora locks a trunk on the platform. Owen runs along the train with his satchel. Nora stamps Owen's pass. Owen climbs aboard.

At night Owen orders tea in the dining car. Lila Moss, a sixty-year-old painter with a grey bun, a green cardigan and a paper fan, sits down opposite him. Lila offers Owen a biscuit. Owen tunes a radio. Owen plays a waltz for Lila. Nora claps from the doorway.

Around midnight Nora checks the sleeper car. Lila searches her bag for her fan. Owen finds the key under the bunk. Lila falls asleep.

At sunrise Nora opens the doors at the mountain station. Owen steps out into the snow. Lila waves her fan from the window. Nora hands Owen a forgotten glove.

At noon Owen plays on a bench at the station for coins. Nora blows the whistle and the train leaves.
